description: ParentNewsletter Translation Dropdown - Add a 'Translate to...' dropdown after generation that makes an AI call to translate the letter into Polish, Urdu, Romanian, Arabic, or Bengali (top 5 UK EAL languages). Show translated version alongside English in a tabbed interface.
steps: Open client/src/pages/tools/ParentNewsletter.tsx which currently uses the AIToolPage shell component.

The AIToolPage component (client/src/components/AIToolPage.tsx) provides a generic generate/display lifecycle. We need to either extend it with a post-generation plugin hook OR convert ParentNewsletter to a standalone component that handles its own generation (simpler given it is the only tool needing this).

Best approach: Add a `renderPostActions` prop to the AIToolPage component that receives (result: string, values: Record<string,string>) and returns ReactNode. This keeps the shell reusable. Render it in the output toolbar area.

In ParentNewsletter.tsx, implement the translation feature using the renderPostActions prop: a) Add a Select dropdown with options: Polish, Urdu, Romanian, Arabic, Bengali. b) When a language is selected, call callAI with a translation system prompt and the generated letter text. c) Store the translated text in component state. d) Show translated text in a Tabs component (English | Translated) below the dropdown.

The translation AI prompt should be: system='You are a professional translator. Translate the following school communication accurately into {language}. Preserve all formatting, dates, and proper nouns. Keep the same paragraph structure.', user=the generated letter text.
Use @radix-ui/react-tabs (already available as shadcn Tabs component) for the English/Translated toggle.
Add a loading state while translation is in progress.
acceptance_criteria: After generating a newsletter, a 'Translate to...' dropdown appears in the output area
Selecting a language triggers an AI call and shows a loading indicator
The translated text appears in a tabbed panel alongside the English original
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors (pnpm run check)
findings: Implementation verified by code review. No build/test commands available due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. All imports reference existing modules (DOMPurify, callAI, shadcn Select/Tabs, lucide-react Languages/Loader2). TypeScript types are consistent - renderPostActions prop signature matches usage. JSX is well-formed.
